description.zh: 设置同时运行的任务个数上限并持久化（1-20，默认 3），超出的任务排队等待。用户说“同时最多跑 N 个任务”之类时使用；立即生效。
description.en: Set and persist how many tasks may run at once (1-20, default 3); further tasks wait in a queue. Use when the user says e.g. "run at most N tasks at a time"; applies at once.

tasks.description: tasks that may run at once (1-20)
